lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are distributed in semi-linear horizontal rows across the visible posterior flank, with primary centroids located in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like alignment on the mid-to-posterior flank region.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density population of small, low-intensity white pixels that are significantly smaller in diameter than the primary flank blobs.
